responsibility: This header declares the public pure-C interface of GCC’s libdiagnostics library for external diagnostic emission. It defines the opaque API types for diagnostic managers, text sinks, files, physical and logical locations, diagnostics, and execution paths; the enums for colorization, SARIF version, logical-location kind, and diagnostic levels; attribute-style compatibility macros for format and nullability checking; and the procedural entry points for manager and sink setup, source-location creation, logical-location construction, diagnostic grouping, metadata attachment, fix-it hints, execution-path events, and final emission of diagnostics to configured sinks.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public pure-C libdiagnostics interface consumed by external clients: it provides the opaque type declarations, enums, attribute macros, and function prototypes, but not the underlying struct definitions, GCC-internal translations, or emission logic implemented in libdiagnostics.cc.
